name: Enthalpy v0.4.25
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.25

## Fixes

- Windows can save large Sync security records in the system credential
  store. This fixes a failure when you connect a remote workspace.
- If the system credential store fails, the workspace list stays available.
  Enthalpy shows the credential error and lets you try the connection again.

## Test the Windows connection

Install this update on each Sync device. If a previous connection failed,
restart Enthalpy and connect the remote workspace again.
